regionalEconomies.heading: Regional economies
regionalEconomies.description: GDP and economic activities for Georgia’s 11 published regions at current prices, 2010–2024.
regionalEconomies.detailMetaDescription: Explore {region} GDP and 20 economic activities at current prices from 2010 through 2024, in GEL and as shares of regional GDP.
regionalEconomies.sourceNote: Source: Geostat regional GDP publications, reviewed 13 September 2026.
regionalEconomies.contextNominal: Regional GDP is at market prices; economic activities are gross value added at basic prices, all in current GEL.
regionalEconomies.contextShare: Each activity is shown as a share of the selected region’s complete market-price GDP.
regionalEconomies.source: Source: Geostat · current prices · annual data
regionalEconomies.accountingNote: Activity shares may total less than 100% because market-price regional GDP includes net product taxes.
regionalEconomies.pickerHint: Use the arrow keys to move and Enter to open a region.
regionalEconomies.highlightsScope: All 20 published activities at the selected final year; current prices.
